about: Cases both motion checks agree on: scripts/motion-lint.mjs (every profile) and the web's motion notes (apps/web/src/canvas/motionNotes.ts, the page profile). expect lists [line, rule] pairs in line order; an empty list means nothing to report.

cases.name: transition all is never right
cases.text:
.a { transition: all .2s; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .a { transition: none; } }

cases.name: a token block defines raw values and uses none
a raw curve and duration outside the tokens
cases.text:
.c { transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .c { transition: none; } }

cases.name: a curve no token or preset names
cases.text: :root { --ease-x: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); }

cases.name: the fallback inside var() is not a raw use
cases.text:
.e { animation: hop var(--dur-slow) var(--ease-emphasis, cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1)) both; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .e { animation: none; } }

cases.name: layout properties in a transition and in keyframes
movement with no reduced-motion path
cases.text:
.g { transition: opacity var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-enter); }
.h { transition: transform var(--dur-base) var(--ease-enter); }

cases.name: fades and colour changes alone need no reduced-motion path
cases.text: .h { transition: opacity var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-enter), color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-enter); }

cases.name: short durations inside the reduced-motion query are the point
comments are not code
cases.text:
/* never transition: all; cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) */
.j { color: red; }

cases.name: a film page reading the clock and chance
cases.text:
<script>
window.renderAt = t => {
  const wobble = Math.random();
  const now = Date.now();
};
</script>

cases.name: the real-time player may read the clock when it says so
cases.text:
<script>
window.renderAt = t => draw(t);
// motion-lint-allow render-clock: the player only chooses t
function play() { const start = performance.now(); }
</script>

cases.name: a page that only calls renderAt is not a film
cases.text:
await frame.evaluate(t => window.renderAt(t), 0.5);
const stamp = Date.now();

cases.name: a Remotion spring written by hand, with a fixed frame rate
a Remotion curve outside the language
cases.text:
import { Easing } from 'remotion';
const e = Easing.bezier(0.05, 0.7, 0.1, 1);

cases.name: a token module may hold the numbers
a spring evaluated by zeta and settle
cases.text:
<script>
window.renderAt = t => {
  const a = springAt(t, 0.8, 0.6);
  const b = springAt(t, 0.3, 2);
};
</script>

cases.name: a deliberate exception on the line above
minified: a keyframes block does not reach the rule after it on the same line
cases.text: @keyframes fade{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}} .card{width:300px;height:200px}

cases.name: minified: every transition on a line is read, not only the first
cases.text: .a{transition:opacity 200ms}.b{transition:width 200ms}

cases.name: a transition value over several lines
React style properties, camel-cased
cases.text: const s = { transitionProperty: 'width', transitionDuration: '200ms' };

cases.name: a shorthand that names its property last
cases.text:
.a { transition: var(--dur-base) var(--ease-move) width; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .a { transition: none; } }

cases.name: all after a comma, and a transition that names no property
a token declaration does not excuse the raw values beside it
cases.text: :root{--dur-base:200ms}.a{transition:opacity 250ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}

cases.name: a MOTION object defines its curves in place
a comment that names reduced motion is not a reduced-motion path
cases.text:
/* TODO: add prefers-reduced-motion */
.a { transition: transform var(--dur-base) var(--ease-enter); }

cases.name: a commented-out renderAt does not make a file a film
cases.text:
// window.renderAt = t => draw(t);
const stamp = Date.now();

cases.name: page profile: prose about motion is not motion
cases.text: Avoid transition: all, because it animates layout like width: 10px.

cases.name: page profile: a page's file name exempts nothing
cases.text:
<style>:root { --ease-a: cubic-bezier(0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 1); }
.x { transition: opacity 200ms cubic-bezier(0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 1); }</style>

cases.name: page profile: a style attribute is read
cases.text: Hi

cases.name: page profile: a delivered page without tokens gets only the judgement-free rules
cases.text:
<style>
.card { transition: all 300ms ease; }
.bar { transition: width 200ms ease; }
</style>

cases.name: page profile: a page that declares tokens is held to them
cases.text:
<style>
:root { --dur-base: 200ms; --ease-enter: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); }
.x { transition: transform 260ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .x { transition: none; } }
</style>

cases.name: page profile: a film page reading chance
cases.text: <script>window.renderAt = t => { const r = Math.random(); };</script>

cases.name: page profile: a page with a motion language of its own is held to its own tokens, not AwwO's
cases.text:
<style>
:root { --ease-pop: cubic-bezier(0.5, 0, 0.5, 1.5); --dur-pop: 320ms; }
.x { transition: transform var(--dur-pop) var(--ease-pop); }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .x { transition: none; } }
</style>

cases.name: page profile: springs and frame rates are left to the page
cases.text:
<script>
const sheet = { type: 'spring', stiffness: 300, damping: 9 };
const calm = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
</script>

cases.name: page profile: a reduced-motion path in script counts
cases.text:
<style>.s { transition: transform 200ms ease; }</style>
<script>const calm = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;</script>

cases.name: CSS timing keywords are curves: ease-in-out and ease-out are none of the language's
linear and steps are not curves the language rejects
cases.text:
.s { animation: spin var(--dur-scene) linear infinite; }
.t { animation: tick var(--dur-scene) steps(4) infinite; }

cases.name: an easing given by name in script: WAAPI, Motion, GSAP
Remotion's named easings are library curves
an .animate call over several lines
a spring config over several lines, and one key alone
a Framer spring transition over several lines
cases.text:
<motion.div animate={{ opacity: 1 }} transition={{
  type: "spring",
  stiffness: 300,
  damping: 30,
}} />

cases.name: a lone damping outside a spring is not a spring
cases.text: const pan = { damping: 0.9, maxSpeed: 40 };

cases.name: a transition assigned in script
cases.text: panel.style.transition = "height 300ms ease";

cases.name: MOTION.md's own MOTION object in a film page is the language, not drift
cases.text:
<script>
const MOTION = {
  dur: { fast: 0.14, base: 0.2, slow: 0.26, scene: 0.4 },
  ease: { enter: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1], move: [0.65, 0, 0.35, 1], exit: [0.3, 0, 0.8, 0.15], emphasis: [0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1] },
  spring: {
    snappy: { stiffness: 520, damping: 36, zeta: 0.79, settle: 0.24 },
    sheet: { stiffness: 380, damping: 32, zeta: 0.82, settle: 0.28 },
  },
};
window.renderAt = (t) => { draw(t); };
</script>

cases.name: a film page: the clock inside renderAt, not in the player around it
cases.text:
<script>
const t0 = performance.now();
const now = () => performance.now() / 1e3 - t0;
window.renderAt = (t) => {
  draw(t, Math.random());
};
function selfTest() { const started = Date.now(); }
</script>

cases.name: renderAt given by name: the named function is the frame
cases.text:
<script>
function draw(t) {
  const x = Date.now();
}
window.renderAt = draw;
</script>

cases.name: a video project holds every file to the clock rule
cases.text: export const jitter = () => Math.random();

a:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); }</style>

cases.text: Hi

cases.text: Hi

cases.name: a function shown in a string does not shadow the one that runs
cases.text:

cases.name: a ternary operand is text, not a property name
cases.text:

const a = b ? 'stiffness' : 300;
const c = d ? 'damping' : 20;

cases.text:
